name: OrganizationPolicy
description: Policy for users of an organization. Restricted to owner actions only; discovery permissions must be granted through explicit roles.

rules.name: OrganizationPolicy-Owner-Rule
rules.description: Allow all operations on an entity for the owner.

rules.name: OrganizationPolicy-NoOwner-Rule
rules.description: Allow anyone to set the owner of an entity that has no owner set.

rules.name: OrganizationPolicy-CDEOwnerViewWorkingRule
rules.description: Allow an assigned owner to view, but not edit, a Glossary or CDE working representation.

rules.name: OrganizationPolicy-CDEAssignedReviewerRule
rules.description: Allow an assigned reviewer to view and review a Glossary or CDE working representation.
